title: Unified: Dungeons Arsenal
description: A Branch of the Unified Mod that adds in weapons from Minecraft Dungeons and the ability to add cosmetic skins to a number of the vanilla weapons/tools
body:
Unified: Dungeons Arsenal is a branch of the Unified Mod. This Mod adds in 5 weapons from Dungeons and their unique variants (Crafted using a Unique Upgrade Template), and the Grim and Wither armor. 

You can also Skin the unique weapons using a cosmetic template. New weapon skins will be added as I update the mod


NOTE: ITS HIGHLY RECOMMENDED USING REI (Roughly Enough Items) WHEN USING THIS MOD SO YOU CAN LEARN ALL THE RECIPES FOR THE WEAPONS AND SKINS

Special Thanks to Doctor4t and Arathain for the inspiration of the skins:

L'ancre (Encrusted Anchor skin)

Reaper's Epitaph (Jailor's Scythe skin)
